chunks: And Yaḥyā ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh, from his father, peace be upon them both.
That he disliked the burquʿ (face veil) and the gloves for a woman in ihram.

key_terms.الْبُرْقُعَ: a face veil worn by a woman
key_terms.الْقُفَّازَيْنِ: a pair of gloves covering the hands
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمَةِ: a woman who is in the state of ihram
key_terms.كَرِهَ: he regarded as disliked or reprehensible

ai.seo_question: What is disliked for a woman to wear while in ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning what a woman in ihram should avoid wearing. It indicates that the burquʿ and gloves are disliked for the muḥrimah during the state of ihram, reflecting specific dress restrictions in the rites of hajj.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2630 - Yahya ibn Abi al-Ala narrated from Abu Abdullah, from his father (as):
"He disliked the use of a niqab (face veil) and gloves for a woman in Ihram."
